mutate true analytic SE column to be the value from the mcse_10M

```{r}
mcse_10M <- mcse_10M |>
  mutate(density_scenario = case_when(
    density_scenario == "1" ~ "Density 1",
    density_scenario == "2" ~ "Density 2",
    density_scenario == "3" ~ "Density 3",
    density_scenario == "4" ~ "Density 4",
  ))
```

find bias % (or whatever relevant stat is best) from that value for the median of (O2, fewster, and bootstrap) 
  - or just some stats
  
```{r}
# Bundle all dataframes into a named list
scenario_list <- list(
  "L1" = L1, "L2" = L2, "L3" = L3, "L4" = L4,
  "L5" = L5, "L6" = L6, "L7" = L7, "L8" = L8,
  "L9" = L9, "L10" = L10, "L11" = L11, "L12" = L12
)

# Map over the list and create a master summary table
summary_table <- bind_rows(scenario_list, .id = "Scenario") |>
  group_by(Scenario, density) |>
  summarize(
    # The baseline SE est
    MC_true = first(MC_10M_est),
    
    # O2 Metrics
    O2_bias = (median(se_O2, na.rm = TRUE) - MC_true) / MC_true * 100,
    O2_sd   = sd(se_O2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Hybrid Analytical (formerly striplets) Metrics
    Hybrid_bias = (median(se_striplet, na.rm = TRUE) - MC_true) / MC_true * 100,
    Hybrid_sd   = sd(se_striplet, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Bootstrap Metrics
    Boot_bias = (median(se_boot_std, na.rm = TRUE) - MC_true) / MC_true * 100,
    Boot_sd   = sd(se_boot_std, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  # Ensure the scenarios stay in numerical order, not alphabetical
  mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = paste0("L", 1:12))) |>
  arrange(Scenario, density)

# View your final formatted numbers
kable(summary_table, digits = 3)
```


```{r}
# Bundle all dataframes into a named list
scenario_list_pts <- list(
  "P1" = P1, "P2" = P2, "P3" = P3, "P4" = P4,
  "P5" = P5, "P6" = P6, "P7" = P7, "P8" = P8,
  "P9" = P9, "P10" = P10, "P11" = P11, "P12" = P12
)

# Map over the list and create a master summary table
summary_table_pts <- bind_rows(scenario_list_pts, .id = "Scenario") |>
  group_by(Scenario, density) |>
  summarize(
    # The baseline SE est
    MC_true = first(MC_10M_est),
    
    # P4 Metrics
    P4_bias = (median(se_P4, na.rm = TRUE) - MC_true) / MC_true * 100,
    P4_sd   = sd(se_P4, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Hybrid Analytical (formerly boxlets) Metrics
    Hybrid_bias = (median(se_boxlet, na.rm = TRUE) - MC_true) / MC_true * 100,
    Hybrid_sd   = sd(se_boxlet, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Bootstrap Metrics
    Boot_bias = (median(se_boot_std, na.rm = TRUE) - MC_true) / MC_true * 100,
    Boot_sd   = sd(se_boot_std, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  # Ensure the scenarios stay in numerical order, not alphabetical
  mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = paste0("P", 1:12))) |>
  arrange(Scenario, density)

# View your final formatted numbers
kable(summary_table_pts, digits = 3)
```
